verdict.rationale: Marlin's pricing page documents a Pro plan at ¥150,000/month with 2,000 credits per month, a cost of 100 credits per run, add-on credit prices, and a warning that cancelled runs still consume credits. That lets a researcher estimate cost and run allowance before committing. However, pricing for the other tiers is not fully laid out, and the add-on discount figures conflict (¥85 vs ¥90 per credit). Missing for 10: complete published pricing and limits for the Team and Enterprise tiers, consistent add-on discount pricing, explicit usage limits beyond credits (e.g. concurrency or rollover), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can understand plan pricing and usage limits before committing

citations.quote: Pro ¥150,000/month ... 2,000 credits / mo ... Discounted add-on credits (¥90 / credit)
Buy credits on demand ... Add-on credits available (¥98 / credit) ... 100 credits per run
You can cancel at any time during execution, but please note that credits will still be consumed.
We have made Marlin available as a pay-per-use tier to monthly Pro, Team, and Enterprise-tier plans.
